verdict.rationale: Undermind documents its own cross-paper extraction: it reads full-text PDFs in parallel, answers specific questions across many papers at once, and generates custom tables. It also offers per-paper relevance judgment with sorting and filtering, which supports a screening-like pass. However, no structured systematic-review workflow with explicit, consistently applied inclusion/exclusion criteria is documented, and a meta-analysis author reported it missed a sample-size exclusion. Missing for 10: explicit user-defined screening criteria applied uniformly across papers, a documented systematic screening→extraction pipeline, independent evidence of consistent criteria application.

support.subject: As a researcher, I can run a systematic screening and extraction workflow across many papers with consistent criteria

citations.quote: Reads full-text PDFs in parallel and answers specific questions across many papers at once, including from figures, tables, and equations.
Generate custom tables to support your research.
Quickly grasp if a paper is relevant to your unique question. Sort and filter however you like.
